CustomField.description: QA fix (Defect #9): captures StageName at the moment a Closed Lost request is submitted (AF_FL_Opp_RequestClosure), so AF_FL_Opp_LostRejected can restore it if the Showroom Manager rejects the request. Never shown to users; internal bookkeeping only.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Internal - captures the stage the Opportunity was in before a Closed Lost request was submitted, so rejection can restore it.
CustomField.label: Stage Before Lost Request
